remarks: Welcome to Silvermine Riverfront. Your dream condo is ready and waiting for you. Imagine starting your day with a cup of coffee gazing out over the Silvermine River on your private balcony, or hosting friends for a delightful dinner in your pristine white kitchen with granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances, including a full-sized dishwasher. The breakfast bar opens up to the living room and dining area, creating an inviting space perfect for entertaining. Your primary bedroom is a haven of comfort with great closet space. The spacious second bedroom is now being used as a luxurious dressing room. It has a huge closet and can easily fit a king bed. The full bathroom has been beautifully updated. There's a powder room and full-size laundry right in the unit. The condo is freshly painted, featuring re-finished hardwood floors and elegant crown mouldings throughout. Two huge storage spaces - the first, a shared space in the hall right by your front door and a second locked storage space in the basement. You'll have your own assigned parking spot, plus plenty of visitor spaces. Just minutes from I-95, Merritt Parkway, trains, and public transportation. Plus, shopping and restaurants are within walking distance. Welcome home!
